patches.reason: Android API 24 guards for WindowInsets and display cutouts; render-view accessor for surface-relative insets; Paseo-authored MakepadInputConnection implements a full Editable-backed IME, UTF-16 text/selection/composition snapshots, batch edits, surrounding-text queries, text/decimal/password/terminal editor metadata (terminal: no auto-capitalization or suggestions), hardware select/copy/cut/paste and native session/revision fencing. Modifier-only keys preserve composition; native acknowledgements cannot overwrite newer unpublished batch edits; hardware characters preserve the existing composing prefix; legacy ACTION_MULTIPLE character strings (deprecated since API 29, still delivered on the API 24 floor) are read in one documented helper. MakepadActivity and MakepadNative connect it to the matching vendored Rust platform, distinguishing editor restarts from same-editor synchronization and avoiding TYPE_NULL restarts between fields. Stationary long presses use current gesture coordinates and scrolling cancels the pending long press. The activity presents capability-limited floating ActionMode text actions, fences stale requests, tracks post-layout selection anchors and preserves UTF-16 clipboard text. API-29 native Magnifier (built with Magnifier.Builder; its size/zoom getters are API 29) follows shared Rust text-handle dragging with a latest-state UI runnable, stationary-sample refresh, viewport-bounded sampling and surface/lifecycle guards. Only the most recently created activity forwards lifecycle and surface callbacks, and it sends Destroy only when finishing, so a stale instance cannot pause, resize or quit the one native app the process serves. The Paseo-authored MakepadAccessibility exposes Rust semantics as virtual SurfaceView nodes with native focus and action routing while accessibility is enabled. MakepadAccessibility.java and MakepadInputConnection.java are new, not upstream files.
